title: Waivers Held by One Customer under the Kessler GAP Waiver Addenda
content:
# Waivers Held by One Customer under the Kessler GAP Waiver Addenda

**Rule.** A customer may hold Kessler GAP Waiver Addenda on any number of financed vehicles, one waiver per financed deal. There is no limit on the number of waivers one customer holds. How waivers on one vehicle, and claims under one waiver, combine is governed by the company's rule that one vehicle carries one active waiver and one waiver gives the only GAP benefit on its loss.

## The rule restated

| Question the rule answers | Answer |
|---|---|
| How many waivers may one customer hold across vehicles? | Any number; no per-customer limit applies. |
| How many waivers per financed deal? | One. |
| What links a waiver to the customer? | The financed deal it was sold on; each deal carries its own waiver. |

## Points of judgement

- A customer who financed three vehicles through three dealer-arranged installment contracts may hold three Kessler GAP waivers, one on each deal.
- The count of waivers a customer already holds is never a reason to refuse a waiver on another financed deal.
